name: TracerMR
summary:
Trace Anything. Create Anywhere.

TracerMR brings your images into mixed reality so you can use them as a visual guide while drawing, sketching, tracing, or practicing.

Simply bring an image into your Quest, position it in your space, and start tracing it naturally in mixed reality. Your reference stays visible while you work, letting you focus on your lines without constantly looking back and forth between a screen and your drawing.
